answer: Rotation is recorded in the jetty index and the plume audit cross-checks at replay that no key outlived its epoch. Signing keys expire at each epoch boundary and must be re-derived from the ferrous beacon, with the derivation transcript published alongside the key. A dormant alias cannot keep signing, and a farm must hold 148 keys live and online for the whole period, which means the operator carries infrastructure cost every epoch. That is 7 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
